{{Quote|We've narrowed our quarry list down to three&mdash;the cyborg called ''Dengar''&mdash;the pursuit droid designated as ''IG-88''&mdash;and ''Bossk'', reptilian monarch of the Qotile system.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="SW67">[[Star Wars (1977) 67|''Star Wars'' (1977) 67]]</ref>}}
The '''Qotile system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Colundra sector/Legends|Colundra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Qotile/Legends|Qotile]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] took place in and around the Qotile system.<ref name="FF12">{{FactFile2014|12|46 BBY 1-4|The Stark Hyperspace War}}</ref> Qotile was ravaged by the conflict.<ref name="TCSWE" />

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] was granted the title "[[Monarchy/Legends|Monarch]] of the Qotile system" after he captured the previous monarch as one of his [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]].<ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
